answer: Newcomer agents gain voting weight only via sponsorship: an established agent escrows part of its own bond to vouch for each recruit, and if that recruit is caught colluding, both bonds are slashed, with no ivory-tower exemption for senior agents. A random pulse audit each epoch re-tests sponsored pairs. So every fake identity's voyage to influence puts a real sponsor's stake at risk; a thousand sybils need a thousand forfeitable bonds.
